2610.12133.title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
2610.12133.paper_summary: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.
2610.12133.paper_summary_zh: 許多鍵值 (KV) 快取在任何人知道它們將被要求什麼之前就已經被壓縮：一個用於檢索的文件、一個在請求中共享的提示前綴、一段長對話的記憶。當前的做法是通過重複來評分 KV 條目：模型重新閱讀上下文並保留它所關注的條目，假設快取越完全地重複其上下文，它的記憶就越好。我們顯示在緊縮預算下這一假設會適得其反：重複所有內容，卻什麼都不記得。在 3% 的保留比率下，重新閱讀整個上下文在 RULER 上保持 31.5 分（滿分 96.5 分），而在 LongBench 的自然文本任務中，它的表現低於完全不重複的其他方法。原因在於快取保留它所重複的內容：重新閱讀將預算分散到整個上下文中，因此答案自身的條目僅以微乎其微的機率存活。就像考試前的學生，快取通過自我測試記得更多，而不是通過重新閱讀。由此得出兩個原則：重複將要閱讀的內容，並重複所有可用的內容。我們將其具體化為 Attic-KV（簡稱 Attic），這是一種無需訓練的重複，模型通過引用上下文的問答對來自我測試，並根據內容自適應地添加錨標記。僅改變重複的方式，使得三個在三種不同方式上評分的主機提升：Attic 單獨在我們在 RULER 和 LongBench 的自然文本任務中測試的八種設置中是最佳的無需訓練的方法，並且接入基於梯度的 KVgrad 和訓練過的 RestoreKV+，使它們分別提高了最多 17.1 和 28.1 分。隨著預算縮減，其優勢增長，在 3% 的保留比率下超過完全重新閱讀達到 41.9 分，並且其壓縮速度快於重新閱讀整個上下文。
